words.enDefinition: personal possessions that someone has accidentally left behind or misplaced

examples.en: The bus company keeps lost property at its main depot during the week.
examples.zh: 公交公司平时把「遗失物品」保存在总站。

examples.en: My keys were logged as lost property after the cleaner found them under a chair.
examples.zh: 保洁员在椅子下面发现了我的钥匙，随后钥匙被登记为「遗失物品」。

words.enDefinition: a form used to report a missing item and describe it

examples.en: I listed the bus route and departure time on the lost property form.
examples.zh: 我在「失物登记表」上写明了公交线路和发车时间。

examples.en: The lost property form asked for the seat number next to the bag.
examples.zh: 「失物登记表」要求填写包旁边的座位号。

collocations: fill in a lost property form

words.enDefinition: a request to check whether someone has found a missing item

examples.en: I made a lost property enquiry about the umbrella after reaching the next stop.
examples.zh: 到了下一站后，我提交了关于那把伞的「失物查询」。

examples.en: The bus company replied to my lost property enquiry with a reference number.
examples.zh: 公交公司回复了我的「失物查询」，并给了一个编号。

collocations: reply to a lost property enquiry

words.enDefinition: to enter the details of something missing in an official system

examples.en: The visitor centre offered to register a loss while I checked the café upstairs.
examples.zh: 我去楼上的咖啡馆找时，游客中心主动提出帮我「登记遗失情况」。

examples.en: I could register a loss online if the station desk was already closed.
examples.zh: 如果车站服务台已经关了，我可以在线「登记遗失情况」。

words.enDefinition: items someone has found after their owners lost them

examples.en: The residence desk keeps found property in a locked cupboard behind the counter.
examples.zh: 宿舍服务台把「拾获物品」保存在柜台后上锁的柜子里。

examples.en: The website lists recent found property without showing details that identify the owners.
examples.zh: 网站列出了最近的「拾获物品」，没有显示能辨认物主的信息。

words.enDefinition: found property that no rightful owner has come to collect

examples.en: The transit company moved its unclaimed property to a warehouse outside the city centre.
examples.zh: 公交公司把「无人认领的物品」搬到了市中心外的一处仓库。

examples.en: We separated the unclaimed property from the bags people were coming to collect.
examples.zh: 我们把「无人认领的物品」与有人来领取的包分开。

words.enDefinition: to give a found possession to the staff responsible for returning it

examples.en: The student stopped at reception to hand in a lost item before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，那名学生顺路到前台「上交捡到的失物」。

examples.en: You can hand in a lost item at either counter in the station lobby.
examples.zh: 车站大厅的两个柜台都可以「上交捡到的失物」。

collocations: hand in a lost item at reception
hand in a lost item to staff
help someone hand in a lost item

words.enDefinition: to pick up belongings that have been found or retrieved

examples.en: The email invited me to collect recovered property at the station after noon.
examples.zh: 邮件通知我中午过后可以到车站「领取找回的财物」。

examples.en: She brought her student card when she went to collect recovered property from reception.
examples.zh: 她去前台「领取找回的财物」时，带上了学生证。

collocations: bring identification to collect recovered property

words.enDefinition: to find out who a particular item belongs to

examples.en: A name inside the jacket helped the staff identify the owner that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，工作人员凭夹克内侧的姓名「确认了物品主人」。

examples.en: The porter used the information on the luggage tag to identify the owner.
examples.zh: 门房利用行李牌上的信息「确认物品主人」。

collocations: use a receipt to identify the owner

words.enDefinition: a noticeable mark that helps distinguish an item from similar ones

examples.en: I mentioned a distinctive mark beside the zip when I described my bag.
examples.zh: 我描述自己的包时，提到了拉链旁一处「显眼的辨认标记」。

examples.en: The red paint spot was the most distinctive mark on the missing helmet.
examples.zh: 那顶丢失的头盔上，红色油漆斑是最「显眼的辨认标记」。

words.enDefinition: a detail that helps someone recognize a particular thing or person

examples.en: The broken clasp was the only identifying feature I could remember about my bracelet.
examples.zh: 我能记起的手链唯一「辨识特征」，就是有个坏掉的扣子。

examples.en: A patch on the sleeve provided an identifying feature for the otherwise plain coat.
examples.zh: 那件外套本来平平无奇，袖子上的一块补丁成了「辨识特征」。

words.enDefinition: a unique number or code assigned to an individual manufactured item

examples.en: The receipt still showed the serial number of the laptop I had bought.
examples.zh: 购物凭条上还印着我买的那台笔记本电脑的「序列号」。

examples.en: I copied the serial number from the box into the lost property form.
examples.zh: 我把盒子上的「序列号」抄进了失物登记表。

words.enDefinition: the first letters of a person's names cut into an item

examples.en: The engraved initials matched my brother's name, but the rest of the keyring looked different.
examples.zh: 「刻上的姓名首字母」和我哥哥的名字对得上，不过钥匙圈其他地方看起来不一样。

examples.en: A photograph of the engraved initials helped me describe the watch to staff.
examples.zh: 我拿着「刻上的姓名首字母」的照片，把手表的特征讲给工作人员听。

words.enDefinition: the objects that are or were inside a particular bag

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the contents of the bag without opening it.
examples.zh: 办事员请我不用打开包，就说出「包里的东西」。

examples.en: I realised the contents of the bag included both of my flat keys.
examples.zh: 我才想起来，「包里的东西」里有我公寓的两把钥匙。

collocations: list the contents of the bag
check the contents of the bag
describe the contents of the bag

words.enDefinition: the things someone owns and carries or keeps with them

examples.en: The school returned my personal belongings in a box after clearing the locker.
examples.zh: 学校清理储物柜后，用一个箱子把我的「个人物品」还给了我。

examples.en: My personal belongings were still under the seat when the bus reached its terminus.
examples.zh: 公交车到终点站时，我的「个人物品」还在座位下面。

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying that someone went away without taking an item

examples.en: I think I left something behind in the study room after our late seminar.
examples.zh: 上完晚上的研讨课，我好像把「什么东西落在」自习室了。

examples.en: She realised she'd left something behind when she reached for her wallet outside.
examples.zh: 她在外面伸手去拿钱包时，才发现自己「落下了东西」。

collocations: check whether you left something behind

words.enDefinition: to put your keys somewhere and then be unable to find them

examples.en: It's easy to misplace your keys when several people share the same hallway table.
examples.zh: 几个人共用走廊小桌时，很容易「把钥匙放错地方」。

examples.en: If you misplace your keys, a flatmate may recognise the coloured tag in the photo.
examples.zh: 如果你「把钥匙放错了地方」，室友也许认得照片里的彩色钥匙牌。

words.enDefinition: a wallet whose owner cannot find it

examples.en: My missing wallet turned up under a loose cushion in the common room.
examples.zh: 我「不见了的钱包」在公共休息室一个活动坐垫下面找到了。

examples.en: I described my missing wallet to the attendant at the swimming pool entrance.
examples.zh: 我向游泳馆入口的工作人员描述了「不见了的钱包」。

words.enDefinition: a bag that someone has taken without the owner's permission

examples.en: The student reported a stolen bag after two witnesses spoke to the station staff.
examples.zh: 两名目击者与车站工作人员沟通后，那名学生报告了「被偷的包」。

examples.en: One of the textbooks from the stolen bag was recovered later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，「被偷的包」里的一本教科书找了回来。

words.enDefinition: a bag that no one appears to be watching or looking after

examples.en: An attendant asked whether the unattended bag beside the bench belonged to our group.
examples.zh: 工作人员问长椅旁那个「无人照看的包」是不是我们这组的。

examples.en: The station announcement referred to an unattended bag in the main waiting area.
examples.zh: 车站广播提到，主候车区有一个「无人照看的包」。

words.enDefinition: to tell an organization that an item can no longer be found

examples.en: I waited by the ticket desk to report an item missing from our coach.
examples.zh: 我在票务台旁等着，准备「报告有件物品落在」我们的大巴上。

examples.en: A resident used the front desk's website to report an item missing on campus.
examples.zh: 一名住宿生通过前台网站「报告一件物品在校园里遗失」。

collocations: call to report an item missing
report an item missing after a trip

words.enDefinition: to notify the responsible authorities that something has been stolen

examples.en: The caretaker showed me the number to call to report a theft in the building.
examples.zh: 管理员告诉我，在楼里「报告失窃」要拨哪个号码。

examples.en: Two students went to the reception desk to report a theft from their locker.
examples.zh: 两名学生到前台「报告储物柜失窃」。

collocations: report a theft to campus security

words.enDefinition: an incident in which something may have been stolen but this is not certain

examples.en: The incident log described the missing equipment as a suspected theft from the storeroom.
examples.zh: 事件记录把设备不见一事登记为储藏室「疑似失窃」。

examples.en: The officer asked whether the suspected theft took place before or after the lecture.
examples.zh: 警员询问「疑似失窃」发生在讲座开始前还是结束后。

words.enDefinition: an official police record containing details of an incident

examples.en: My landlord requested a copy of the police report for the recovered bicycle.
examples.zh: 房东请我提供有关找回自行车一事的「警方事件记录」副本。

examples.en: The officer read back part of the police report to check the timeline.
examples.zh: 警员读了一部分「警方事件记录」给我听，以核对时间线。

words.enDefinition: a UK police reference assigned to a report recorded as a crime

examples.en: The officer gave me a crime reference number after recording the theft of my bag.
examples.zh: 记录我的包被偷一事后，警员给了我一个「英国警方案件编号」。

examples.en: I copied the crime reference number into the box on the insurer's form.
examples.zh: 我把「英国警方案件编号」抄到保险公司表格的对应框里。

words.enDefinition: the taking of belongings from inside a vehicle without permission

examples.en: The car park notice mentioned a recent theft from a vehicle outside the gym.
examples.zh: 停车场告示提到，体育馆外最近发生过一起「车内财物被盗」事件。

examples.en: The officer recorded the missing backpack as a theft from a vehicle on campus.
examples.zh: 警员把背包失踪登记为校园内一起「车内财物被盗」事件。

collocations: investigate a theft from a vehicle

words.enDefinition: the act or occurrence of taking someone else's bicycle without permission

examples.en: The student emailed campus security about a bike theft near the back entrance.
examples.zh: 那名学生给校园安保部门发邮件，反映后门附近的「自行车失窃」事件。

examples.en: The safety office counted each reported bike theft in its monthly summary for residents.
examples.zh: 安保部门在给住户的月报中统计了每起被报告的「自行车失窃」。

words.enDefinition: stealing belongings from someone's clothing or bag without being noticed

examples.en: The visitor leaflet mentioned pickpocketing as a concern in crowded areas around the station.
examples.zh: 游客宣传单提到，车站周边人多的地方要留意「扒窃」。

examples.en: The officer asked whether the missing wallet might be a case of pickpocketing.
examples.zh: 警员问钱包不见了，会不会是遇到了「扒窃」。

words.enDefinition: a label for belongings that are missing or were taken without permission

examples.en: The issuer's form asked whether my travel pass was lost or stolen that evening.
examples.zh: 发卡机构的表格问，我的交通卡当晚是「遗失还是被盗」。

examples.en: The account listed several cards that had already been reported as lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 账户里列出了几张已申报「遗失或被盗」的卡。

collocations: mark a card as lost or stolen

words.enDefinition: possessions that someone has taken without the owner's permission

examples.en: The officer kept a separate list of stolen property recovered near the station.
examples.zh: 警员单独列了一张在车站附近找回的「被盗财物」清单。

examples.en: The shop found one of my missing items among the stolen property brought in.
examples.zh: 店员在送来的「被盗财物」中找到了我丢失的一件物品。

words.enDefinition: belongings that have been located or retrieved after being lost or taken

examples.en: The campus desk called to say some recovered property matched the details I'd given.
examples.zh: 校园服务台来电说，有些「已找回的财物」和我提供的特征相符。

examples.en: We checked the recovered property list before making a second trip to the station.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「已找回财物」清单，才第二次前往车站。

words.enDefinition: a receipt confirming that an office handed a held item back

examples.en: The attendant gave me a property release receipt after handing back my bag.
examples.zh: 工作人员把包还给我后，给了我一张「财物交还凭条」。

examples.en: The property release receipt recorded who had collected the item and when.
examples.zh: 「财物交还凭条」记录了谁在什么时候领走了物品。

words.enDefinition: a record used to track items reported lost or handed in

examples.en: The staff entered the umbrella in the lost property register under Tuesday's date.
examples.zh: 工作人员把伞录入「失物登记册」，登记在周二的日期下。

examples.en: We checked the lost property register for bags found on the same bus.
examples.zh: 我们查了「失物登记册」，看看同一辆公交车上有没有捡到包。

collocations: entry in the lost property register

words.enDefinition: a reference used to find a specific lost property report or record

examples.en: I gave the clerk my lost property reference to check the status of the enquiry.
examples.zh: 我把「失物查询编号」报给办事员，请对方查看查询进展。

examples.en: The lost property reference was printed at the top of the reply email.
examples.zh: 「失物查询编号」印在回复邮件的顶部。

words.enDefinition: a label attached to an item so it can be matched to a record

examples.en: The registrar tied a property tag to the handle of the recovered suitcase.
examples.zh: 登记员把「财物登记标签」拴到找回的行李箱提手上。

examples.en: The property tag had the same number as the entry in the storage ledger.
examples.zh: 「财物登记标签」上的编号与保管台账对应条目上的编号相同。

collocations: match a property tag to a record

words.enDefinition: a receipt recording that an office or organization took custody of an item

examples.en: The attendant gave me a property receipt after I handed over the recovered wallet.
examples.zh: 我交上找回的钱包后，工作人员给了我一张「财物接收凭证」。

examples.en: The property receipt described the headphones and recorded when the desk took them in.
examples.zh: 「财物接收凭证」描述了耳机的特征，并记录了服务台接收耳机的时间。

words.enDefinition: a record of when, where, or how missing property was regained

examples.en: The officer added the bicycle's colour to the record of recovery before closing the file.
examples.zh: 结案前，警员把自行车的颜色写进了「财物找回记录」。

examples.en: The record of recovery showed that a student had found the wallet near campus.
examples.zh: 「财物找回记录」显示，一名学生在校园附近捡到了钱包。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a held item has been given back to its owner

examples.en: The case was marked property returned after the owner picked up the backpack.
examples.zh: 物主取走背包后，记录被标为「财物已归还」。

examples.en: I noticed the property returned status when I checked the enquiry page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上查看查询页时，我看到了「财物已归还」的状态。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that missing property has yet to be retrieved

examples.en: The insurer's form still showed property not recovered for the missing laptop that week.
examples.zh: 那周，保险公司的表格上，遗失的笔记本电脑仍显示为「财物尚未找回」。

examples.en: The office recorded property not recovered before sending its final reply to the passenger.
examples.zh: 办事处在发给乘客最终回复前，把状态登记为「财物尚未找回」。

collocations: property not recovered at this time

words.enDefinition: the calendar date on which an item or document went missing

examples.en: I entered the date of loss using the date printed on my train ticket.
examples.zh: 我按火车票上印的日期填写了「遗失日期」。

examples.en: The application asked for the date of loss in a separate field near the top.
examples.zh: 申请表在顶部附近设有单独一栏，要求填写「遗失日期」。

words.enDefinition: the location where an item or document went missing

examples.en: I listed the station lobby as the place of loss on the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格上把车站大厅填为「遗失地点」。

examples.en: The office asked me to narrow down the place of loss within the shopping centre.
examples.zh: 办事处请我把「遗失地点」具体到购物中心内的某处。

words.enDefinition: an estimate of when a possession or document went missing

examples.en: I checked the café receipt before estimating the approximate time of loss for my bag.
examples.zh: 我先看了咖啡馆的收据，才估算包的「大致遗失时间」。

examples.en: The attendant entered my approximate time of loss as early on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 工作人员输入的「大致遗失时间」是周五傍晚。

collocations: give an approximate time of loss
record the approximate time of loss
ask for the approximate time of loss

words.enDefinition: the facts and events surrounding the disappearance of an item

examples.en: I explained the circumstances of loss in a short note attached to the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格所附的一张简短说明里写了「遗失经过」。

examples.en: The adviser asked about the circumstances of loss before reviewing my travel arrangements.
examples.zh: 顾问先问了「遗失经过」，再查看我的出行安排。

collocations: details of the circumstances of loss

words.enDefinition: a written account describing what went missing and under what circumstances

examples.en: I gave the office a statement of loss describing where I last saw the document.
examples.zh: 我给办事处提交了一份「遗失情况说明」，写明最后一次见到文件的地点。

examples.en: The adviser read my statement of loss before discussing a replacement document with me.
examples.zh: 顾问读了我的「遗失情况说明」，再和我商量补发文件的事。

words.enDefinition: a formal declaration that a particular document or item is missing

examples.en: I read the declaration of loss carefully before signing it at the desk.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「正式遗失声明」，然后才在服务台签字。

examples.en: The clerk added the declaration of loss to the file containing my passport correspondence.
examples.zh: 办事员把「正式遗失声明」放入保存我护照往来函件的档案里。

words.enDefinition: an official document confirming that someone reported a loss

examples.en: The consulate in Vientiane asked for a certificate of loss for the missing passport.
examples.zh: 万象的领事办事处请我提供那本遗失护照的「遗失报备证明」。

examples.en: My adviser asked whether the certificate of loss was already in my document folder.
examples.zh: 顾问问我，「遗失报备证明」是否已放进文件夹。

collocations: copy of a certificate of loss

words.enDefinition: a list of the particular objects that are missing

examples.en: I sent the accommodation office a missing item list after checking the storage locker.
examples.zh: 检查完储物柜后，我向住宿办公室发送了一份「遗失物品清单」。

examples.en: The missing item list included a blue notebook as well as the laptop sleeve.
examples.zh: 「遗失物品清单」上既有笔记本电脑内胆包，也有一本蓝色笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a passport whose holder cannot find it

examples.en: I told the consular officer that my lost passport was probably on the train.
examples.zh: 我告诉领事官员，「遗失的护照」可能落在了火车上。

examples.en: The lost passport turned up in a sleeve inside my old travel bag.
examples.zh: 「遗失的护照」在我旧旅行包的夹层里找到了。

words.enDefinition: a passport taken without the holder's permission

examples.en: The officer included the stolen passport in the report about my missing backpack.
examples.zh: 警员在有关背包丢失的报告中也写进了「被盗护照」。

examples.en: The consulate asked when I had last seen the stolen passport before the trip.
examples.zh: 领事馆问我，出发前最后一次看到「被盗护照」是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: a report formally notifying an authority that a passport is missing

examples.en: I saved a copy of the lost passport report in my travel documents folder.
examples.zh: 我在旅行证件文件夹里留了一份「护照遗失报告」的副本。

examples.en: The office confirmed the lost passport report was linked to my earlier enquiry.
examples.zh: 办事处确认，「护照遗失报告」已关联到我之前的查询。

words.enDefinition: the formal act of making an issued passport no longer valid

examples.en: The message confirmed the passport cancellation and gave the date it took effect.
examples.zh: 消息确认了「护照注销」，并写明生效日期。

examples.en: I looked for the passport cancellation notice among the replies from the passport office.
examples.zh: 我在护照办事处的回复里找「护照注销」通知。

words.enDefinition: an official message verifying that a passport has been cancelled

examples.en: The passport cancellation confirmation identified which travel document had been made invalid.
examples.zh: 「护照注销确认通知」写明了哪本旅行证件已作废。

examples.en: I filed the passport cancellation confirmation with the other messages from the consulate.
examples.zh: 我把「护照注销确认通知」与领事馆发来的其他消息一起存档。

words.enDefinition: to label an item or document in a record as missing or stolen

examples.en: The adviser explained which record the system would flag as lost or stolen after review.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了审核后系统会把哪条记录「标记为遗失或被盗」。

examples.en: The form asked which of my two cards to flag as lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 表格问我两张卡中要把哪张「标记为遗失或被盗」。

collocations: flag a card as lost or stolen
flag a document as lost or stolen
flag an item as lost or stolen

words.enDefinition: not valid or usable any more for its intended purpose

examples.en: The notice said that my old residence card was no longer valid after replacement.
examples.zh: 通知上说，居留卡补发后旧卡「已经失效」。

examples.en: I found the original pass, but the desk confirmed it was no longer valid.
examples.zh: 我找到了原来的通行证，但服务台确认它「已经失效」。

collocations: confirm that something is no longer valid

words.enDefinition: the process of making an official document cease to be valid

examples.en: The office recorded the date of document invalidation beside the original file number.
examples.zh: 办事处在原案卷编号旁记录了「证件作废」的日期。

examples.en: The letter confirmed document invalidation before a replacement was issued the following week.
examples.zh: 信中确认了「证件作废」，补发件于下一周签发。

words.enDefinition: help available from a country's consular officials to its nationals abroad

examples.en: The student sought consular assistance after discovering her passport was missing during the exchange.
examples.zh: 那名学生在交流期间发现护照不见了，便寻求了「领事协助」。

examples.en: The office arranged consular assistance for several travellers who had lost their documents.
examples.zh: 办事处为几名遗失证件的旅客安排了「领事协助」。

words.enDefinition: a telephone line for urgent communication with a consular service

examples.en: The orientation leaflet lists a consular emergency line for students travelling outside the country.
examples.zh: 迎新宣传单上列出了供出国学生使用的「领事紧急联系电话」。

examples.en: I saved the consular emergency line alongside the regular office number in my contacts.
examples.zh: 我在通讯录里同时保存了「领事紧急联系电话」和办事处的普通电话。

words.enDefinition: a physical visa document that the holder cannot find

examples.en: The immigration adviser asked whether I had saved a copy of my lost visa.
examples.zh: 移民事务顾问问我，是否保存了「遗失签证」的副本。

examples.en: I listed the date of issue of my lost visa in the written account.
examples.zh: 我在书面说明中写明了「遗失签证」的签发日期。

collocations: record details of a lost visa

words.enDefinition: a physical residence card that its holder can no longer find

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to describe my lost residence card on the enquiry form.
examples.zh: 我请教顾问，该怎样在查询表上说明「遗失的居留卡」。

examples.en: The office asked whether I had a photograph of the lost residence card on file.
examples.zh: 办事处问我的档案里是否留有「遗失的居留卡」照片。

collocations: copy of a lost residence card

words.enDefinition: a record notifying an organization that an official document is missing

examples.en: I included the city and date in my document loss report for the office.
examples.zh: 我在交给办事处的「证件遗失报告」里写明了城市和日期。

examples.en: The adviser checked the document loss report against the copies in my student file.
examples.zh: 顾问把「证件遗失报告」与学生档案里的副本进行了核对。

collocations: copy of a document loss report

words.enDefinition: a student identity card that the holder cannot find

examples.en: My lost student ID was found in the lecture theatre after the evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课结束后，有人在阶梯教室找到了我「遗失的学生证」。

examples.en: The desk asked where I had last used my lost student ID on campus.
examples.zh: 服务台问我上一次在校园哪里用过这张「遗失的学生证」。

words.enDefinition: a record confirming a held item has been collected

examples.en: The desk emailed an item collection confirmation after my sister picked up the bag.
examples.zh: 姐姐取走包后，服务台发来一封「物品领取确认」邮件。

examples.en: I kept the item collection confirmation with the photographs from my original enquiry.
examples.zh: 我把「物品领取确认」与最初查询时用的照片一起保存。

words.enDefinition: an identity document issued for use for a limited time

examples.en: The campus desk gave me a temporary ID while my new card was being printed.
examples.zh: 新卡还在打印时，校园服务台给了我一张「临时身份证件」。

examples.en: The examiner checked the expiry date on my temporary ID before marking me present.
examples.zh: 监考人员查看了我的「临时身份证件」的到期日，然后登记我已到场。

words.enDefinition: a short-term pass allowing someone to enter specified campus areas

examples.en: The residence office issued a temporary campus pass while it checked the missing card report.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室核查卡片遗失报告期间，发了一张「校园临时通行证」。

examples.en: My temporary campus pass let me use the main gate for one day.
examples.zh: 凭「校园临时通行证」，我当天可以从正门出入。

words.enDefinition: to make a card stop working for entry to secured areas

examples.en: The residence office offered to cancel an access card after reviewing my report.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室审阅报告后，提出可以「注销门禁卡」。

examples.en: The desk asked which building I meant before agreeing to cancel an access card.
examples.zh: 服务台先问我说的是哪栋楼，才同意「注销门禁卡」。

collocations: ask staff to cancel an access card
report a loss and cancel an access card

words.enDefinition: a new access card issued in place of an earlier one

examples.en: I collected my replacement access card on the way back from the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我从阶梯教室回来的路上领到了「补发的门禁卡」。

examples.en: The residence office confirmed that my replacement access card would work at both entrances.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室确认，「补发的门禁卡」在两个入口都能用。

words.enDefinition: a key made or supplied in place of one that was lost or damaged

examples.en: The caretaker left a replacement key in a sealed envelope for me at reception.
examples.zh: 管理员把「补配的钥匙」装进密封信封，放在前台让我取。

examples.en: I tested the replacement key with the caretaker before taking it back upstairs.
examples.zh: 我和管理员试了试「补配的钥匙」，然后才把它带回楼上。

words.enDefinition: to replace existing locks so that their previous keys no longer work

examples.en: We asked the landlord whether she planned to change the locks after the reported loss.
examples.zh: 报失后，我们问房东是否打算「更换门锁」。

examples.en: The building manager arranged to change the locks while most residents were in class.
examples.zh: 多数住户上课时，楼管安排了人员「更换门锁」。

collocations: ask permission to change the locks

words.enDefinition: a bus travel pass that its holder cannot find

examples.en: The transit desk sent me an email about my lost bus pass after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，公交服务台给我发了一封关于「遗失的公交卡」的邮件。

examples.en: I reported my lost bus pass at the station desk on Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四下午，我在车站服务台报告了「公交卡遗失」一事。

collocations: hand in a lost bus pass

words.enDefinition: a transport pass issued in place of one that is lost or unusable

examples.en: The clerk confirmed where I could pick up my replacement travel pass that afternoon.
examples.zh: 办事员确认了当天下午我可以去哪里领取「补发的交通卡」。

examples.en: I tested my replacement travel pass on the bus outside the students' union.
examples.zh: 我在学生会大楼外的公交车上试了一下「补发的交通卡」。

collocations: apply for a replacement travel pass

words.enDefinition: a debit card that its holder cannot locate

examples.en: The bank's message confirmed that my lost debit card had been reported on Monday.
examples.zh: 银行的消息确认，「遗失的借记卡」已于周一报失。

examples.en: I checked that the lost debit card was the one named in the notice.
examples.zh: 我确认那张「遗失的借记卡」就是通知中提到的卡。

words.enDefinition: a credit card that someone has taken without the cardholder's permission

examples.en: The bank asked which recent purchases might have been made with the stolen credit card.
examples.zh: 银行询问近期有哪些消费可能是用「被盗的信用卡」完成的。

examples.en: I gave the officer the details of the stolen credit card for the report.
examples.zh: 我向警员提供了「被盗的信用卡」的资料，以便记录在报告中。

collocations: suspected use of a stolen credit card

words.enDefinition: a message confirming a card issuer has recorded a reported loss

examples.en: I saved the card loss confirmation with the reference number from the bank.
examples.zh: 我把「银行卡挂失确认」和银行给的编号一起保存。

examples.en: The card loss confirmation showed the date I first contacted the bank about it.
examples.zh: 「银行卡挂失确认」上写着我最初联系银行报告这件事的日期。

words.expression: match a found item to a report
words.lemma: match a found item to a report
words.zhGloss: 把拾获物与报失记录匹配
words.enDefinition: to identify which loss report describes a particular found item
acceptedZhAnswers: 把拾获物与报失记录匹配
acceptedEnVariants: match a found item to a report

examples.en: It is easier to match a found item to a report when the description includes a label.
examples.zh: 报失描述写明了标签，工作人员就更容易「把拾获物与报失记录匹配」。

examples.en: Staff use photographs to match a found item to a report from its owner.
examples.zh: 工作人员用照片「把拾获物与物主的报失记录匹配」起来。

collocations: match a found item to a report by its markings
use a photo to match a found item to a report
try to match a found item to a report

words.enDefinition: permanently making an existing card unusable for future transactions

examples.en: The bank recorded the date of card cancellation in its message to me.
examples.zh: 银行在发给我的消息中记录了「银行卡注销」日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my new card was due to arrive after the card cancellation.
examples.zh: 我查看了新卡是否会在「银行卡注销」后送到。

words.enDefinition: a phone line for reporting a missing payment card

examples.en: The banking app shows the lost card hotline on its account help page.
examples.zh: 银行应用在账户帮助页面上标出了「银行卡挂失热线」。

examples.en: I dialled the lost card hotline using the number printed in my bank booklet.
examples.zh: 我照着银行手册上印的号码拨打了「银行卡挂失热线」。

words.enDefinition: money taken from an account without the owner's permission

examples.en: The statement showed an unauthorised withdrawal while I was away from campus on Friday.
examples.zh: 对账单显示，周五我离开校园期间有一笔「未经授权的取款」。

examples.en: I asked the bank to review the unauthorised withdrawal listed under the cash transactions.
examples.zh: 我请银行核查现金交易里的这笔「未经授权的取款」。

words.enDefinition: in UK fraud reporting, obtaining someone's personal details without their permission

examples.en: The adviser explained why identity theft was a concern after my documents went missing.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了证件遗失后，为什么要留意「身份资料被盗」。

examples.en: I saved the report about possible identity theft after discovering my ID was missing.
examples.zh: 我发现证件不见了，便存下了「身份资料可能被盗」的报告。

words.enDefinition: in UK fraud reporting, using stolen personal details to deceive someone for gain

examples.en: The bank investigated possible identity fraud after receiving an application I did not recognise.
examples.zh: 银行收到一份我不知情的申请后，调查了可能的「冒用身份欺诈」。

examples.en: I saved the notice saying the identity fraud enquiry was still open on Friday.
examples.zh: 我保留了那份通知，上面说截至周五「冒用身份欺诈」调查尚未结束。

words.enDefinition: a phrase indicating that personal information could be exposed or misused

examples.en: The notice listed the types of personal data at risk after a device went missing.
examples.zh: 设备遗失后，通知列出了「面临风险的个人数据」类型。

examples.en: The review found the only personal data at risk was an old address list.
examples.zh: 审查发现，唯一「面临风险的个人数据」是一份旧地址清单。

collocations: identify the personal data at risk
review the types of personal data at risk

words.enDefinition: to temporarily stop a mobile line from providing calls or network access

examples.en: I asked whether the provider could suspend mobile service without closing my account.
examples.zh: 我问运营商能不能在保留账户的同时「暂停手机通信服务」。

examples.en: The provider confirmed when it would suspend mobile service on the missing phone.
examples.zh: 运营商确认了何时「暂停遗失手机的通信服务」。

collocations: suspend mobile service for a lost phone

words.enDefinition: to prevent a subscriber identity card from connecting to a mobile network

examples.en: The provider confirmed it could block a SIM card without cancelling my phone number.
examples.zh: 运营商确认，可以在不注销我手机号码的情况下「停用SIM卡」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why it might take a moment to block a SIM card.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了为何「停用SIM卡」可能需要一点时间。

collocations: ask a carrier to block a SIM card
request to block a SIM card

words.enDefinition: a new SIM supplied to replace one that is missing or no longer usable

examples.en: My replacement SIM arrived in a small envelope from the network provider on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四，运营商用一个小信封寄来了「补发的SIM卡」。

examples.en: The shop assistant checked my order before handing me the replacement SIM that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，店员核对订单后，把「补发的SIM卡」交给了我。

words.enDefinition: to record a device or item as missing in an account or system

examples.en: The device list showed which tablet I could mark as lost in the account.
examples.zh: 设备列表显示，我可以在账户中把哪台平板「标记为遗失」。

examples.en: The help page explained which items the staff could mark as lost for students.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了工作人员可以为学生把哪些物品「标记为遗失」。

collocations: choose an item to mark as lost
device you can mark as lost

words.enDefinition: an Apple feature that helps secure a missing device and display a message

examples.en: My account showed that Lost Mode was active on the phone I'd left behind.
examples.zh: 我的账户显示，落下的那部手机已启用「苹果设备丢失模式」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why Lost Mode still showed as pending on the device list.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为何设备列表上「苹果设备丢失模式」仍显示待启用。

words.enDefinition: a feature or command that locks a device from another location

examples.en: The university's mobile help page explained when a remote lock could take effect.
examples.zh: 大学手机帮助页面解释了「远程锁定设备」的操作何时可以生效。

examples.en: The support technician confirmed that the remote lock was pending while the phone was offline.
examples.zh: 技术支持人员确认，手机离线期间，「远程锁定设备」的操作仍在等待生效。

words.enDefinition: the process of regaining access to an account you cannot currently use

examples.en: I contacted the campus help desk about account recovery after losing my old phone.
examples.zh: 旧手机遗失后，我联系了校园技术服务台咨询「账号找回」。

examples.en: The website showed the expected waiting time for account recovery under my case reference.
examples.zh: 网站在我的工单编号下显示了「账号找回」预计需要的等待时间。

words.enDefinition: an email address set up to help a user regain account access

examples.en: I found the confirmation message in the inbox for my recovery email that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在「账号找回邮箱」的收件箱里找到了确认邮件。

examples.en: The campus portal asked me to verify my recovery email before continuing the request.
examples.zh: 校园门户网站要求我验证「账号找回邮箱」，才能继续办理。

words.zhGloss: 退出所有设备上的登录
words.enDefinition: to end the active logins for an account on all connected devices
acceptedZhAnswers: 退出所有设备上的登录

examples.en: The support team explained what would happen if I chose to sign out of all devices.
examples.zh: 支持团队解释了选择「退出所有设备上的登录」后会发生什么。

examples.en: I saw the option to sign out of all devices on the account page.
examples.zh: 我在账户页面上看到了「退出所有设备上的登录」的选项。

collocations: option to sign out of all devices
choose to sign out of all devices
button labelled “Sign out of all devices”

words.enDefinition: a device recognized by an account service for confirming the user's identity

examples.en: The service still listed my old tablet as a trusted device after I replaced it.
examples.zh: 我换了平板后，该服务仍把旧平板列为「受信任的设备」。

examples.en: A message appeared on my trusted device when I tried to access the account.
examples.zh: 我尝试访问账户时，「受信任的设备」上出现了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: to formally remove a permission allowing someone or something to use a resource

examples.en: The librarian asked IT to revoke access for the missing staff card that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，图书管理员请 IT 部门对遗失的员工卡执行「撤销访问权限」操作。

examples.en: The support team confirmed that it could revoke access for my old device.
examples.zh: 支持团队确认，可以对我的旧设备执行「撤销访问权限」操作。

words.enDefinition: a status saying the user can use their account again

examples.en: The help desk marked the request account access restored after I confirmed I could sign in.
examples.zh: 我确认能登录后，技术服务台把申请标为「账号访问已恢复」。

examples.en: I received an account access restored message from the university's support team that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我收到学校支持团队发来的「账号访问已恢复」消息。

collocations: mark a ticket account access restored

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that a password has been changed or reset

examples.en: The password reset confirmation appeared in my inbox shortly before the next lecture.
examples.zh: 下一节课开始前不久，我的收件箱里收到了「密码重置确认通知」。

examples.en: I kept the password reset confirmation while the support desk looked at my case.
examples.zh: 技术服务台查看我的情况时，我保留了「密码重置确认通知」。

words.enDefinition: a pickup notice saying the collector needs to show identification

examples.en: The email said “ID required for collection” below the address of the bus depot.
examples.zh: 邮件在公交总站的地址下方写了「领取时须出示证件」。

examples.en: I saw “ID required for collection” on the counter sign when I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到达时，看到柜台的标牌上写着「领取时须出示证件」。

collocations: the sign reads “ID required for collection”
a reminder that ID is required for collection

words.enDefinition: an electronic collection of records about lost and found objects

examples.en: The clerk searched the lost property database by date and bus route.
examples.zh: 办事员按日期和公交线路查询「失物数据库」。

examples.en: I checked the lost property database again after the driver finished her shift.
examples.zh: 公交司机下班后，我又查了一次「失物数据库」。

collocations: enter an item in the lost property database

words.enDefinition: written permission allowing another person to collect an item on the owner's behalf

examples.en: My sister showed written authorization for collection when she picked up my lost backpack.
examples.zh: 姐姐代领我遗失的背包时出示了「书面代领授权」。

examples.en: The clerk kept the written authorization for collection with the other papers about my keys.
examples.zh: 办事员把「书面代领授权」和有关我那串钥匙的其他材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a person given permission to pick something up for its owner

examples.en: My roommate was listed as the authorized collector when the office scheduled the pickup.
examples.zh: 办事处安排领取时间时，将我的室友列为「获准代领人」。

examples.en: The authorized collector signed for the bag and received a copy of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「获准代领人」签收了包，并拿到一份凭条副本。

words.enDefinition: the process of getting rid of found items no one has claimed

examples.en: The transit website explained its unclaimed property disposal policy in a separate section.
examples.zh: 公交网站设有单独的栏目，解释「无人认领财物处置」政策。

examples.en: The board discussed unclaimed property disposal after reviewing the number of items in storage.
examples.zh: 委员会查看保管的物品数量后，讨论了「无人认领财物处置」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the original owner has come forward for an item

examples.en: The system showed claimed by the owner beside the umbrella I had handed in.
examples.zh: 系统在我上交的那把伞旁显示「已被物主认领」。

examples.en: The porter marked the headphones claimed by the owner after checking the name.
examples.zh: 门房核对姓名后，把耳机标为「已被物主认领」。

collocations: marked as claimed by the owner

words.enDefinition: stored with someone responsible for keeping the item safe until collection

examples.en: The wallet was held in safekeeping behind the desk until I came back.
examples.zh: 钱包一直在服务台后面「暂时妥善保管」，直到我回来。

examples.en: The email confirmed the phone would be held in safekeeping until Friday evening.
examples.zh: 邮件确认，手机会「暂时妥善保管」到周五傍晚。

collocations: keep an item held in safekeeping

words.enDefinition: the length of time an organization keeps recovered belongings available for collection

examples.en: The lost property page states the property storage period for items found on trains.
examples.zh: 失物招领网页写明了火车上拾获物品的「失物保管期限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the property storage period began on the day the wallet was found.
examples.zh: 我问「失物保管期限」是不是从找到钱包当天开始算。

words.enDefinition: a website where people submit information to an authority or organization

examples.en: I found the campus reporting portal on the student services page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在学生服务网页上找到了校园「线上申报平台」。

examples.en: The reporting portal let me attach a photograph of the missing bag before submission.
examples.zh: 「线上申报平台」允许我在提交前附上遗失包的照片。

collocations: submit a report through the reporting portal

words.enDefinition: an electronic report submitted to notify the authorities about stolen property

examples.en: I saved my online theft report as a PDF after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 我提交「网上失窃报案」后，把记录保存为 PDF。

examples.en: The officer asked a question about the time listed in my online theft report.
examples.zh: 警员就我的「网上失窃报案」中填写的时间问了一个问题。

collocations: copy of the online theft report

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that someone received an incident report

examples.en: The report acknowledgement included a contact address for questions about my missing bike.
examples.zh: 「报案收件确认」中有一个联系地址，可用于询问丢失的自行车。

examples.en: I saved the report acknowledgement separately from the later decision about my case.
examples.zh: 我把「报案收件确认」和之后关于本案的决定分开保存。

words.expression: add information to a police report
words.lemma: add information to a police report
words.zhGloss: 给警方事件记录补充信息
words.enDefinition: to provide additional details about an incident that has already been reported to police
acceptedZhAnswers: 给警方事件记录补充信息
acceptedEnVariants: add information to a police report

examples.en: I called to add information to a police report after finding my original receipt.
examples.zh: 找到原始收据后，我打电话「给警方事件记录补充信息」。

examples.en: The officer told me whom to contact to add information to a police report.
examples.zh: 警员告诉我，要「给警方事件记录补充信息」可以联系谁。

collocations: call to add information to a police report
ask to add information to a police report
form to add information to a police report

words.enDefinition: a fee that may be charged when someone collects a stored item

examples.en: The desk listed the lost property collection charge separately from the shipping cost.
examples.zh: 服务台把「失物领取费」和运费分开列出。

examples.en: I asked about the lost property collection charge before going to the depot.
examples.zh: 我去车场前问了一下「失物领取费」。

collocations: pay a lost property collection charge
waive a lost property collection charge
check the lost property collection charge

words.enDefinition: a small label attached to a set of keys to identify them

examples.en: I described the key tag as blue with a room number written on it.
examples.zh: 我说「钥匙标牌」是蓝色的，上面写着一个房间号。

examples.en: A resident recognised the key tag in the photograph of my missing keys.
examples.zh: 一名住户认出了我遗失钥匙的照片里的「钥匙标牌」。

words.enDefinition: a phrase describing something forgotten when someone got off a bus

examples.en: The umbrella was left on the bus near the seats by the back door.
examples.zh: 伞「落在公交车上」了，就在后门旁那些座椅附近。

examples.en: I asked the driver whether a blue folder had been left on the bus.
examples.zh: 我问司机有没有一个蓝色文件夹「落在公交车上」。

collocations: report an item left on the bus

words.enDefinition: a business or service that arranges or provides taxi rides

examples.en: I asked the taxi operator whether a driver had handed in a blue notebook.
examples.zh: 我问「出租车运营方」有没有司机交来一本蓝色笔记本。

examples.en: The taxi operator looked up our booking after I gave the time we left.
examples.zh: 我报了出发时间后，「出租车运营方」查到了我们的预约记录。

collocations: report a loss to the taxi operator

words.enDefinition: to look in the pocket attached to a seat for something

examples.en: The attendant offered to check the seat pocket after I described my missing glasses.
examples.zh: 我描述丢失的眼镜后，乘务员主动提出「查看座椅背袋」。

examples.en: I went back to check the seat pocket before leaving the cinema that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午离开电影院前，我折回去「查看座椅背袋」。

collocations: remember to check the seat pocket
ask someone to check the seat pocket
go back to check the seat pocket

words.enDefinition: the number identifying a specific locker used to store personal items

examples.en: I gave the porter my storage locker number before he opened the register.
examples.zh: 门房打开登记册前，我向他报了「储物柜编号」。

examples.en: The storage locker number was still printed on the slip from the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 游泳馆的凭条上还印着「储物柜编号」。

words.enDefinition: information that can be used to get in touch with the owner

examples.en: The owner's contact details were written inside the cover of the lost notebook.
examples.zh: 遗失笔记本的封面里面写有「物主的联络资料」。

examples.en: The porter added the owner's contact details to the form before storing the bag.
examples.zh: 门房把包存放起来前，在表格上补写了「物主的联络资料」。

words.expression: return an item to its owner
words.lemma: return an item to its owner
words.enDefinition: to give a recovered object back to the person it belongs to
acceptedEnVariants: return an item to its owner

examples.en: Staff can return an item to its owner after checking the name on its label.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对标签上的姓名后，可以「把物品归还给物主」。

examples.en: The caretaker used the school register to return an item to its owner.
examples.zh: 管理员利用学校登记册「把物品归还给物主」。

collocations: help return an item to its owner
arrange to return an item to its owner
try to return an item to its owner

words.enDefinition: belongings that another person has turned over to a responsible office

examples.en: The desk checks property handed in each morning against the list of reported losses.
examples.zh: 服务台每天早上用报失清单核对「有人交来的财物」。

examples.en: My wallet was among the property handed in after the football match last night.
examples.zh: 我的钱包就在昨晚足球赛后「有人交来的财物」中。

words.zhGloss: 未找到符合描述的物品
words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a search found no item fitting a description
acceptedZhAnswers: 未找到符合描述的物品

examples.en: The email said no matching item found after staff checked the depot's shelves.
examples.zh: 工作人员查过总站的架子后，邮件写着「未找到符合描述的物品」。

examples.en: I saw no matching item found when I reopened the lost property enquiry that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚我重新打开失物查询，看到「未找到符合描述的物品」。

collocations: status reads no matching item found
no matching item found so far

words.enDefinition: a status saying an item was transferred to a transport company's storage facility

examples.en: The umbrella had been sent to the depot before I reached the station that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午我到车站前，雨伞「已送到车场保管」。

examples.en: The update showed sent to the depot beside the description of my blue bag.
examples.zh: 更新内容在我的蓝包描述旁显示「已送到车场保管」。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating an organization has stopped processing a request for information

examples.en: The page showed enquiry closed after I confirmed I had collected the item.
examples.zh: 我确认取到物品后，页面显示「查询已结束」。

examples.en: I received an enquiry closed message after the station replied that nothing matched my description.
examples.zh: 车站回复没有符合描述的物品后，我收到了一条「查询已结束」的消息。

words.enDefinition: the calendar date when someone gave a found item to staff

examples.en: The date handed in was one day later than the date I lost it.
examples.zh: 「上交日期」比我弄丢它的日期晚一天。

examples.en: The porter noted the date handed in beside the umbrella's description in the log.
examples.zh: 门房在登记表的雨伞描述旁记下了「上交日期」。

words.enDefinition: to explain which items or information are inside something

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the contents before he brought the bag out.
examples.zh: 办事员把包拿出来前，请我「描述里面的东西」。

examples.en: I could describe the contents of the pouch but not the colour of its zip.
examples.zh: 我能「描述里面的东西」，但说不出小袋拉链的颜色。

collocations: describe the contents of a bag
ask a caller to describe the contents

words.enDefinition: marked with a label bearing your name to identify the item

examples.en: The attendant asked whether the instrument case was labelled with your name or only initials.
examples.zh: 工作人员问乐器盒上是「贴有你的姓名标签」，还是只有姓名首字母。

examples.en: Make sure the laptop sleeve labelled with your name is the one the clerk found.
examples.zh: 确认一下，办事员找到的是「贴有你的姓名标签」的那个电脑内胆包。

words.enDefinition: the first receipt issued as evidence of an item's purchase

examples.en: I found the original purchase receipt in the envelope that came with the headphones.
examples.zh: 我在耳机附带的信封里找到了「原始购买凭条」。

examples.en: The attendant compared the serial number with my original purchase receipt before releasing the laptop.
examples.zh: 工作人员交给我笔记本电脑前，将序列号与「原始购买凭条」进行了核对。

words.enDefinition: to allow a held item to be taken away by someone entitled to it

examples.en: The office agreed to release the property after comparing my ID with the record.
examples.zh: 办事处将我的证件与记录核对后，同意「交还保管的财物」。

examples.en: The clerk signed the form to release the property to my authorized collector.
examples.zh: 办事员签署表格，把「保管的财物交还」给我授权的代领人。

collocations: release the property to its owner

words.enDefinition: the physical state of an item when it is handed back

examples.en: The form asked me to describe the item condition on return before I signed.
examples.zh: 表格要求我签字前描述「物品领回时的状况」。

examples.en: The desk recorded the item condition on return after I checked the broken clasp.
examples.zh: 我检查了坏掉的扣子后，服务台记录了「物品领回时的状况」。

collocations: description of item condition on return
